text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
K.S.Miracle stopped when she saw
a street piano in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a street piano.
Come to think of it... I haven't played the piano
much lately...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll play a little before heading home?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure...!?
Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle gently
and joyfully
began to play a pop song.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Waaa! You're so good at that!
I was totally captivated listening to it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that big a deal, really...
Still, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Um... this might be sudden,
but I'm a piano UmaTuber!
Would you like to be in one of my videos!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-Appearing in it...?
Me...?

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm planning a segment where I have a showdown with a pianist I run into around town!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
I've been asking someone who plays wonderfully
to join us!
Except... they keep turning me down...

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I was thinking of canceling the project,
I happened to hear your performance...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see, is that so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Could you wait just a moment?
I'd like to help with the video...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
I'll go give it my best.

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
You'll accept it?!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then let's get right to it!
Let's head over to that stage!
They've got two pianos over there!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, what kind of things
do you do in a piano showdown?"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of either a speed-run of 'Flea Waltz',
or a medley battle playing songs in a word chain!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
The rules of speed shredding are just as they sound!
Both players start playing at the same time,
and whoever finishes 30 reps first wins!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: In a medley battle, we take turns playing songs chained together like a word game. Whoever stops playing loses!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
And so, please choose whichever one
you like best!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, both sound fun.
Let's see... Trainer, which one
do you think is better?
choice_data_list: Let's have a song title shiritori showdown!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A contest of pure speed, huh...
Yeah, that really fires me up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll give it everything I've got.
Since you went out of your way to ask me,
I'll respond with everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Preparations were complete, and the photoshoot began!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as for the countdown,
I'll leave it in your capable hands!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An even start!
Neither giving an inch, they've started playing at incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
My, my~ "Flea Waltz"?
Fufufu, that was so fast~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? Th-This isn't normal!
What incredible speed...—Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I-I can see it... A cat dancing at high speed!!
I've never heard 'Flea Waltz'
played like this before in my life!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Pulling overwhelmingly far ahead of the competition,
K.S.Miracle finished her performance first!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the great match!
Your speed was amazing!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you as well.
...It brings back memories. The kids were so excited when I played for them before, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The faster I shredded, the more hyped they got,
which made me put even more energy into practicing...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope everyone has
a lot of fun watching this video too."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It looks fun to get to play so many songs.
I'm so excited to see what kind of music she'll play."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Still, a match is a match... Having fun is great and all, but I'll make sure to take my performance seriously."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Preparations were complete, and the photoshoot began!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: As the host of this channel, I'll let you go first. ...Now, please!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then first off...

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
—!
Ooh, "Snail"...! 
Going with a nursery rhyme, are we!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: Then I'll go with a pop song!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is this... "Peak Sensitivity Reaction"?!
It's super trendy right now, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll go with this, then.

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Another nursery rhyme?
"Donguri Korokoro", ro, ro...
I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, as the relay went back and forth for multiple rounds, K.S. Miracle kept competing using only nursery rhymes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—"The little carp are the children,
Swimming playfully along♪"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
Ri, ri... 'Koinobori' ends with 'ri'...
...Umm, uhh... Urgh.
I-I yield...!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd surpass my repertoire
with nursery rhymes alone...!
I've learned so much! Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
I just wanted to cater to everyone's tastes,
so I wanted to learn all sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I hope lots of girls sing along to this video.
